decision: The card flips to its back instead of showing a details page
why: People look for the card number where it is on a physical card.
value: Familiar gesture, and the back explains how to reveal safely.

decision: Installment options always show the total effective cost (CET)
why: Credit is only fair if the real cost is visible next to the monthly amount.

decision: Revealing the virtual card number needs a fresh biometric or PIN step-up
why: A stolen unlocked phone should not expose a usable card number.
alternative: Show the number whenever the app is open.
value: Card fraud risk drops without friction for everyday use.

decision: Limit increases are suggested by the model but approved by credit operations
why: Customer-facing credit changes need the same review as applications.
value: One credit policy across ops and the app.
